description: This file contains a Roslyn diagnostic analyzer that enforces a coding rule preventing properties in certain grain interface types from being declared, specifically those implementing 'Orleans.Runtime.IAddressable'. The analyzer inspects property declarations within interfaces, skips static members, and reports diagnostics if a property is found in an interface that extends the specified base interface.

classes.name: GrainInterfacePropertyDiagnosticAnalyzer
classes.description: A Roslyn analyzer that checks properties in interfaces, ensuring they do not belong to interfaces that implement 'Orleans.Runtime.IAddressable'.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Sets up the analyzer, configuring it to analyze generated code and report diagnostics on property declarations.

methods.name: AnalyzeSyntax
methods.description: Analyzes property syntax nodes, determines whether they belong to relevant interfaces, and reports diagnostics if necessary.

methods.name: SupportedDiagnostics
methods.description: Property getter that returns the diagnostic descriptors supported by this analyzer.
